verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents consent capture, syncing consent preferences downstream, and PII blocking or masking. These are adjacent privacy features. Nothing documents processing user deletion or suppression requests, or forwarding them to connected destinations. For a CDP this axis clearly applies, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can process user deletion and suppression requests (GDPR/CCPA) and have them forwarded to connected destinations
